title: 70% of Microsoft's AI revenue comes from OpenAI, contributing $24.1 billion in fiscal year
excerpt: The latest disclosed information shows that OpenAI has become a major revenue source for Microsoft's artificial intelligence business. In the fiscal year ending
content_html:
The latest disclosed information shows that OpenAI has become a major revenue source for Microsoft's artificial intelligence business. In the fiscal year ending in June this year, OpenAI contributed approximately $24.1 billion in revenue to Microsoft, accounting for about 70% of Microsoft's total AI revenue.

According to Bloomberg, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella previously stated in early March that the company's AI business is expected to achieve a target of over $37 billion in annual revenue. According to their cooperation agreement, OpenAI needs to pay Microsoft for computing resource costs, model development-related expenses, and share part of the revenue.

OpenAI's significant contribution to Microsoft's AI business has also influenced Microsoft's recent strategic statements in the field of artificial intelligence. Known for its commercial software ecosystem and platform lock-in capabilities, Microsoft has recently started actively promoting open-source model development and emphasized avoiding a small number of closed-source AI models controlling the entire industry's value distribution.

Nadella had previously expressed his views on the controversy surrounding "model distillation" in the AI industry. Model distillation refers to using data or output results from large proprietary models to train smaller models with lower costs. Some AI companies believe this practice may weaken their technological advantages, while Microsoft has questioned related restrictions.

At the same time, Microsoft is gradually reducing its reliance on external models and integrating more of its self-developed artificial intelligence models into core products such as Office. According to reports, the company is pushing for adjustments in the Copilot ecosystem to reduce costs associated with OpenAI and other third-party models.

As generative AI commercialization enters a deeper stage, Microsoft and OpenAI are both partners and potential competitors. Balancing model supply, commercial revenue, and the development of autonomous AI capabilities will become an important issue in Microsoft's future artificial intelligence strategy.

content_html_zh:
最新披露的信息显示，OpenAI已成为微软人工智能业务的主要收入来源。 在今年6月结束的财年中，OpenAI为微软贡献了约241亿美元的收入，约占微软AI总收入的70%。

据彭博社报道，微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉此前在 3 月初表示，公司 AI 业务预计实现年收入超过 370 亿美元的目标。 根据双方合作协议，OpenAI需要向微软支付计算资源成本、模型开发相关费用，并分享部分收入。

OpenAI对微软AI业务的重大贡献也影响了微软近期在人工智能领域的战略表述。 以商业软件生态和平台锁定能力着称的微软，最近开始积极推动开源模型开发，并强调避免少数闭源AI模型控制整个行业的价值分配。

纳德拉此前曾就AI行业围绕“模型蒸馏”的争议表达了自己的看法。 模型蒸馏是指使用大型专有模型的数据或输出结果以较低的成本训练较小的模型。 一些人工智能公司认为这种做法可能会削弱他们的技术优势，而微软则对相关限制提出质疑。

与此同时，微软正在逐步减少对外部模型的依赖，将更多自研的人工智能模型融入到Office等核心产品中。 据报道，该公司正在推动 Copilot 生态系统的调整，以降低与 OpenAI 和其他第三方模型相关的成本。

随着生成式AI商业化进入更深层次，微软和OpenAI既是合作伙伴，也是潜在的竞争对手。 平衡模型供应、商业收入和自主AI能力的发展将成为微软未来人工智能战略的重要问题。
